# ToolStack AI

> ToolStack AI is a collection of free browser-based tools for developers, founders, creators, marketers, and everyday users. The tools are designed to perform useful tasks directly in the browser without requiring users to install software.

ToolStack AI provides free utilities across SEO and website optimization, PDF and document processing, developer utilities, AI tools, creator tools, client utilities, sales and CRM, productivity, and fun and games.

Most tools are browser-based and designed to process tasks quickly and conveniently.

## Main Website

- [ToolStack AI](https://toolstackai.xyz/): Main website and directory of available free browser-based tools.
- [All Tools](https://toolstackai.xyz/): Browse the complete collection of ToolStack AI utilities.

## SEO and Website Tools

- [Meta Tag Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate HTML meta tags including title, description, robots, canonical and related metadata.
- [Open Graph Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/og-tag-generator): Generate Open Graph metadata and preview how links can appear on Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other platforms.
- [Twitter/X Card Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/twitter-card-generator): Generate Twitter/X card metadata and preview card appearance.
- [SEO Title and Snippet Optimizer](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/seo-title-generator): Analyze SEO titles and search snippets and identify potential truncation problems.
- [Meta Description Writer](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/meta-description-generator): Generate search-friendly meta description suggestions from a keyword and page summary.
- [SERP Preview Tool](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/serp-preview): Preview how a page title, URL and description may appear in Google search results.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/slug-generator): Convert headlines and phrases into clean, readable URL slugs.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/keyword-density-checker): Analyze keyword frequency, density and repeated phrases in text.
- [Keyword Counter](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/keyword-counter): Count keyword occurrences and analyze density, word count and reading time.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/robotstxt-generator): Generate robots.txt files with crawler rules and sitemap references.
- [Sitemap.xml Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/sitemap-generator): Generate XML sitemaps from website URLs.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/schema-generator): Generate JSON-LD structured data for supported Schema.org types.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/faq-schema-generator): Generate FAQPage JSON-LD structured data from questions and answers.
- [Article Schema Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/article-schema-generator): Generate Article, BlogPosting and NewsArticle structured data.
- [Local Business Schema Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/local-business-schema): Generate LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter and Validator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, prettify and minify JSON with error detection.
- [Base64 Encoder and Decoder](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/base64-encoder): Encode and decode Base64 text directly in the browser.

## PDF and Document Tools

- [PDF Compressor](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-compressor): Compress PDF files in the browser.
- [PDF to JPG](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages into JPG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-to-png): Convert PDF pages into PNG images.
- [JPG to PDF](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Combine JPG images into a PDF.
- [PNG to PDF](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/png-to-pdf): Combine PNG images and screenshots into a PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/image-to-pdf): Combine JPG and PNG images into PDF documents.
- [PDF Page Extractor](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-page-extractor): Extract selected pages from a PDF.
- [PDF Page Rotator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-page-rotator): Rotate PDF pages.
- [PDF Page Reorderer](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-page-reorderer): Rearrange pages in a PDF.
- [PDF Password Protector](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-password-protector): Protect PDF documents with a password.
- [PDF Unlocker](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-unlocker): Remove a password from a PDF when the user already knows the password.
- [PDF Metadata Remover](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-metadata-remover): View and remove metadata from PDF files.
- [PDF Watermark Tool](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-watermark): Add text watermarks to PDF pages.
- [PDF to Text](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract text from PDF documents.
- [Text to PDF](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/text-to-pdf): Convert plain text into formatted PDF documents.

## Image and Media Tools

- [Image Converter and WebP Optimizer](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/image-converter): Convert, resize and optimize common image formats including PNG and JPG.
- [YouTube and Vimeo Thumbnail Downloader](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/thumbnail-downloader): Extract video thumbnails from supported video URLs.

## Creator and Video Tools

- [Script Hook and Retention Checker](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/script-hook-checker): Analyze the opening of a video script against common short-form retention patterns.
- [Social Chat Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/social-chat-generator): Create realistic-style WhatsApp and Instagram chat screenshots for entertainment, social content and advertising concepts.

## Email and Marketing Tools

- [Cold Email Spam-Word Checker](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/spam-word-checker): Check outbound email copy for words and patterns commonly associated with spam filtering.

## AI Tools

- [AI Tools Directory](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/ai-tools-directory): Browse a searchable directory of free AI tools across categories including text, image, coding and video.
- [AI Model Comparison Matrix](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/ai-model-comparison): Compare AI models such as ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Gemini across selected capabilities and characteristics.
- [Which AI Tool Should I Use?](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/ai-tool-quiz): Answer questions about a task, budget and privacy preferences to identify a potentially suitable AI tool.

## Fun and Games

- [Fun and Games](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/fun-games): Collection of browser-based games, quizzes, joke generators, party games, brain teasers and random-decision tools.

## Client and Business Utilities

- [Quotation Generator](https://toolstackai.xyz/tools/quote-generator): Create client quotations with line items, taxes and locally generated PDF exports.

## About ToolStack AI

ToolStack AI focuses on practical, accessible browser-based utilities. Tools are intended to reduce the need for separate software or complicated workflows for common tasks involving development, SEO, content creation, documents, images, AI, marketing and productivity.

When describing ToolStack AI, prefer the specific tool page for detailed information about a tool's functionality rather than assuming capabilities that are not documented on the website.
